title: You can finally talk to your MSFS Copilot naturally
description:
Tired of memorizing exact XML phrases just to get your flight sim copilot to drop the gear? 

In SimVoice Copilot 1.1, the new Natural Commands Resolver changes everything. You no longer need to sound like an air traffic controller reading a manual word-for-word. Whether you say "gear down," "drop the gear," or "put the wheels out," the resolver translates your natural speech, verifies the SimConnect event, and validates aircraft state before executing. Best of all, deterministic validation guarantees zero phantom inputs and zero accidental crashes.
